titles.romaji: Sora no Otoshimono Final: Eien no Watashi no Torikago
titles.english: Heaven's Lost Property Final – The Movie: Eternally My Master
titles.native: そらのおとしものＦｉｎａｌ永遠の私の鳥籠［エターナルマイマスター］

description:
The second movie of Sora no Otoshimono

Beautiful and otherworldly Ikaros’ connection with Tomoki is deeper than she originally thought. Now she’s starting to feel empty and confused—with new emotions she’s not had much experience with. How will she pick up the pieces after what comes next?

(Source: Crunchyroll)
